title: Auto loan cosigner - responsibility
facts: A cosigner on an auto loan generally becomes legally responsible for the debt if the primary borrower does not pay according to the contract.
Late payments and defaults can affect a cosigner's credit as well as the primary borrower's credit when reported.
Cosigning does not necessarily give the cosigner ownership rights in the vehicle; title ownership and loan liability are separate legal concepts.
Federal rules require specified cosigner notices in covered consumer credit transactions.
